title: Clarium is excluded on geography alone: a US managed-services entry in the Flowable directory
content:
Clarium's entry in the Flowable Partner Finder amounts to a service model and a location: managed services, Miami, outside the EU. The do-not-pitch call rests on the geography, and no other disqualifier is recorded against it.

That thinness is a property of the sweep rather than of the firm. The directory was mined on 2026-08-18 and the rows were not imprint-swept, so anything not printed on the partner card is simply absent. For entries excluded on geography, no further research was warranted — the exclusion applies before any of the qualitative criteria come into play.

The useful implication is about reversibility. Entries screened out purely on location — Clarium, Fulcrum Digital, Myridius, Perficient, dxdy — are the cheapest set to revisit if the EU-only constraint is ever relaxed, precisely because nothing substantive was found against them. That is a materially different status from firms excluded for OEM behaviour, product conflict or divided allegiance, and the two should not be collapsed into one do-not-pitch bucket.
